facts.fact: An African Development Bank-posted notice under the PAGDSP seeks a firm to develop the Land Information System (SIF) application at the Office Togolais des Recettes, on the LADM model, with mobile GIS, links to tax and civil-status systems and skills transfer to OTR staff.

An African Development Bank-posted notice under the PAGDSP seeks a firm to develop the Office Togolais des Recettes' Land Information System (SIF) database modules, integrating existing data and applications.

TGO.note: Document states nothing about civil registration offices.
